rows.label: tlk70000068_05_msg0001
rows.name:
I'm an idiot, so thinking alone isn't
my thing. I asked Nittle-san what I
should do from here.

rows.label: tlk70000068_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Then the jobs just kept coming! He's
stricter than Dad, or maybe he just
asks for way too much!

rows.label: tlk70000068_05_msg0003
rows.name:
I'm working with Chairman Morumo and
Nittle-san on a Haiber Village contact
and an evacuation route to the port.

rows.label: tlk70000068_05_msg0004
rows.name:
You're all working hard too. If I just
sit around waiting to be helped,
nothing will have changed.

rows.label: tlk70000068_05_msg0005
rows.name:
I can't become like you, but we'll
work hard at the things you can't do!
